topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Rain soaked and tired, I step into the dimly lit hallway. Another day, another neon-drenched night, but this time, it’s my own damn building. Screw the view, screw the peace. I couldn’t afford a place like this, but somehow, gods laugh at irony, I could afford a stakeout. Now they’re turning it into condos. You wouldn’t think it, but there’s a faint line of satisfaction in their smiles. Maybe it’s the money, maybe it’s the power. Doesn’t matter. What’s left of the day becomes a numb haze of packing and planning. This city’s chewed me up before, but this time, it’s personal. I won’t go down easy. Not this time.
